name: OAK-D RGB IMX378 12MP

derivation.rounding: QGroundControl stores sensor size to 0.01 mm and focal length to 0.1 mm; the rounded ratio changes GSD by 0.06 %
sources: DepthAI-derived 12 MP intrinsics from the factory 1920x1080 calibration (docs/oak-d-hardware.md)

mounting: Landscape means the image width lies across the flight track. PX4 must yaw along each leg (MIS_YAWMODE 0) and the OAK must be mounted nadir with its image width across the vehicle.
limitations: The 12 MP intrinsics are derived from a 1080p calibration, not measured at 12 MP (#14)
RGB is rolling shutter; readout time is unmeasured
